strategy.title: Strategies (RHP)
strategy.body:
- Enhance scale, global competitiveness and financial flexibility to grow revenue, production volume, market share and shareholder returns.
- Pursue cost optimization, competitive pricing, improved production processes and enhanced customer satisfaction to meet competitive pressure.
- Continue investing in Research & Development to improve product quality.
- Reduce employee turnover and maintain a congenial work environment as part of human-resource strategy.
